title: Support chatbot
subtitle: Sample questions, knowledge, conversations and settings of the Tào assistant
noKey: The chatbot is not signed in to ChatGPT, so it is off for users. Go to Settings > ChatGPT account to sign in.

source.learned: Learned from {{conversations}} conversations: {{candidates}} new answers to review, {{variants}} new phrasings

dialog.createBody: When a message matches closely, the bot replies with this exact answer without calling the AI.

field.question: Question
field.title: Title
field.content: Markdown content (each ## section is one chunk)

reviewHint: Questions learned from chats or imported from Zalo are only used after approval. Check that prices and fixes are still correct and remove customer details before enabling.
docsHint: Documents hold long answers: tool errors, Ngân Lượng pricing… Editing a document marks the sample questions based on it as “Needs re-check”.
docBody: The bot may only answer from these sections. Never include bank account numbers.

settings.maxHistory: History messages sent to the AI
settings.dailyMessagesPerUser: Max messages per user per day (0 = unlimited)
settings.zaloHandoffText: Message when handing off to Zalo ({code} = support code)
settings.rulesNote: Safety rules (no made-up facts, no tool prices, no bank account numbers, only the customer's own data) are fixed and cannot be changed here.

toast.approved: Approved — the bot now uses this answer
toast.learned: Learned from {{conversations}} conversations: {{candidates}} new answers to review, {{variants}} new phrasings
toast.learnSkipped: The chatbot is off, learning skipped

account.title: Chatbot ChatGPT account
account.hint: The chatbot answers with the Codex SDK running on this ChatGPT account. Sign in with a code: no popup — copy the link and code into a browser on any device.
account.logoutConfirm: Sign out of ChatGPT? The chatbot will be off for users until you sign in again.
account.step1: Open this link in a browser (any device) and sign in to ChatGPT:
account.step3: Confirm on that page. This card updates automatically when done.
account.superOnly: Only a Super Admin can view and change the chatbot's ChatGPT account.

toast.loggedOut: Signed out — the chatbot is off

account.deviceHelp: Sign-in page says "Enable device code sign-in…"? Turn on "Device code sign-in" in that ChatGPT account's security settings, then Cancel and sign in again for a new code:

quota: The chatbot's ChatGPT account hit its USAGE LIMIT ({{time}}): customers get a "temporarily busy" reply and are pointed to Zalo. Sample-answer matches still work. Wait for the limit to reset or sign in with a higher-plan account in Settings. Details: {{message}}
